evolutionOfSelfDischargeRate.description: Current self-discharge rate as percentage per month, showing evolution from initial

numberOfFullEquivalentChargingCycles.description: Total number of full equivalent charging cycles completed

capacityThroughput.description: Cumulative charge passed through the battery over its life, in ampere-hours

energyThroughput.description: Cumulative energy passed through the battery over its life, in kilowatt-hours

numberOfChargingEvents.title: Number of Charging Events
numberOfChargingEvents.description: Total number of charging events (partial or full) recorded

dateOfServiceEntry.description: Date when the battery was first put into service

negativeEvents.title: Negative Events
negativeEvents.description: Record of negative events such as deep discharge, extreme temperatures, or accidents

currentStateOfCharge.title: Current State of Charge — SoC
currentStateOfCharge.description: Current state of charge of the battery as a percentage

temperatureConditionsHistorical.title: Temperature Conditions Historical
temperatureConditionsHistorical.description: Historical record of temperature conditions the battery has been exposed to

batteryModelIdentifier.title: Battery Model Identifier
batteryModelIdentifier.description: Manufacturer's model or type identifier for this battery (distinct from the unique item-level identifier).

ceMarkingStatus.title: CE Marking Status
ceMarkingStatus.description: Whether the product bears CE marking and its validity

extinguishingAgent.title: Extinguishing Agent
extinguishingAgent.description: Suitable extinguishing agent(s) for a fire involving this battery, and the applicable fire class.

renewableContentShare.title: Share of Renewable Content
renewableContentShare.description: Percentage share of renewable content in the battery (Annex XIII 1(f))

roundTripEfficiencyAtHalfCycleLife.title: Round-Trip Energy Efficiency at 50% of Cycle-Life
roundTripEfficiencyAtHalfCycleLife.description: Energy round-trip efficiency measured at 50% of the battery's rated cycle-life (Annex XIII 1(n) DP 37). Distinct from the t=0 measurement in initialEnergyRoundTripEfficiency.

componentPartNumbers.title: Part Numbers for Components
componentPartNumbers.description: Part numbers for components subject to replacement, per Annex XIII 2(b). Structured list with component name and part number.

dynamicPowerCapability.title: Power Capability (Dynamic, in W)
dynamicPowerCapability.description: In-service power capability in watts, measured dynamically per Annex XIII 4(a) DP 53. Distinct from originalPowerCapability which is the static nameplate value at manufacture.

dynamicEnergyRoundTripEfficiency.title: Energy Round-Trip Efficiency (Dynamic, %)
dynamicEnergyRoundTripEfficiency.description: Where applicable, in-service energy round-trip efficiency percentage per Annex XIII 4(a) DP 57. Conditional for all three battery categories.

dynamicRatedCapacity.title: Rated Capacity (Dynamic, in Ah)
dynamicRatedCapacity.description: In-service capacity in ampere-hours, measured dynamically per Annex XIII 4(a) DP 51. The guidance defines it as "same as data point 11 (capacity), but now dynamic" — so it is the same quantity as ratedCapacity (Annex XIII 1(g)) re-measured in service, not a second nameplate figure.

dynamicInternalResistance.title: Internal Resistance (Dynamic, in Ω)
dynamicInternalResistance.description: In-service internal resistance in ohms, measured dynamically per Annex XIII 4(a) DP 55. Distinct from initialInternalResistancePack (Annex XIII 1(o)), the static value at manufacture, and from currentInternalResistancePack (Annex XIII 4(b)), which is the state-of-health reading that must not be filled for EV.

dynamicExpectedLifetimeCycles.title: Expected Lifetime (Dynamic, in cycles)
dynamicExpectedLifetimeCycles.description: Expected remaining lifetime in cycles under the battery's design reference conditions, per Annex XIII 4(a) DP 59 — the in-service re-estimate. Distinct from expectedLifetimeCycles (Annex XIII 1(j)), the design figure declared at manufacture. Excluded for non-cycle applications.

remainingRoundTripEfficiency.title: Remaining Round-Trip Efficiency
remainingRoundTripEfficiency.description: Where possible, the remaining energy round-trip efficiency as part of the state-of-health information per Annex XIII 4(b) DP 64. Applies to LMT batteries (mandatory); conditional for industrial; not applicable to EV.

preConsumerRecycledNickelShare.title: Pre-Consumer Recycled Nickel Share
preConsumerRecycledNickelShare.description: Percentage of Nickel from pre-consumer recycled waste in the battery's active materials. Complements the combined recycledContentNickel figure by splitting it into waste-origin streams per Annex XIII 1(e).

preConsumerRecycledCobaltShare.title: Pre-Consumer Recycled Cobalt Share
preConsumerRecycledCobaltShare.description: Percentage of Cobalt from pre-consumer recycled waste in the battery's active materials. Complements the combined recycledContentCobalt figure by splitting it into waste-origin streams per Annex XIII 1(e).

preConsumerRecycledLithiumShare.title: Pre-Consumer Recycled Lithium Share
preConsumerRecycledLithiumShare.description: Percentage of Lithium from pre-consumer recycled waste in the battery's active materials. Complements the combined recycledContentLithium figure by splitting it into waste-origin streams per Annex XIII 1(e).

postConsumerRecycledNickelShare.title: Post-Consumer Recycled Nickel Share
postConsumerRecycledNickelShare.description: Percentage of Nickel from post-consumer recycled waste in the battery's active materials. Complements the combined recycledContentNickel figure by splitting it into waste-origin streams per Annex XIII 1(e).

postConsumerRecycledCobaltShare.title: Post-Consumer Recycled Cobalt Share
postConsumerRecycledCobaltShare.description: Percentage of Cobalt from post-consumer recycled waste in the battery's active materials. Complements the combined recycledContentCobalt figure by splitting it into waste-origin streams per Annex XIII 1(e).

postConsumerRecycledLithiumShare.title: Post-Consumer Recycled Lithium Share
postConsumerRecycledLithiumShare.description: Percentage of Lithium from post-consumer recycled waste in the battery's active materials. Complements the combined recycledContentLithium figure by splitting it into waste-origin streams per Annex XIII 1(e).

originalPowerCapabilityAt80Soc.title: Original Power Capability at 80% SoC
originalPowerCapabilityAt80Soc.description: Power capability of the battery at 80% state of charge (Watts). Together with the 20% SoC figure forms the OriginalPowerCapability GEFEG composite required by Annex XIII 1(i).

originalPowerCapabilityAt20Soc.title: Original Power Capability at 20% SoC
originalPowerCapabilityAt20Soc.description: Power capability of the battery at 20% state of charge (Watts). Together with the 80% SoC figure forms the OriginalPowerCapability GEFEG composite required by Annex XIII 1(i).

temperatureInformation.title: Temperature Information
temperatureInformation.description: Single Celsius temperature figure characterising the battery's thermal operating or design condition (integer, can be negative). Distinct from temperatureConditionsHistorical, which is a descriptive record of historical temperature ranges.

cadmiumLeadSymbolsUrl.title: Cadmium and Lead Symbols URL
cadmiumLeadSymbolsUrl.description: URI linking to the artwork or documentation for the cadmium and lead chemical symbols required to be marked on the battery per Art. 13(5). Complements the cadmiumSymbol and leadSymbol boolean fields, which only indicate presence.

componentPartNumbersUrl.title: Component Part Numbers URL
componentPartNumbersUrl.description: URI linking to a list of part numbers for components and spare parts of the battery per Annex XIII 2(b). Complements the componentPartNumbers array field, which holds the structured part-number list; this URI field satisfies the GEFEG format:uri requirement.

sparePartsSourcesUrl.title: Spare Parts Sources URL
sparePartsSourcesUrl.description: URI linking to information on sources where spare parts can be obtained for the battery per Annex XIII 2(b). When present, takes precedence over the URL derived from the sparePartsInformation.catalogUrl field in the GEFEG export.

accidentsInformationUrl.title: Accidents Information URL
accidentsInformationUrl.description: URI linking to information on accidents relating to the battery per Annex XIII 4(d). Complements the negativeEvents array field, which holds structured event records; this URI field satisfies the GEFEG format:uri requirement.
